Excludes Mollie's two home markets (BE/NL). Refunds can be counted as volume against the promo (Mollie's T&Cs wording). Not combinable with other offers ('not valid with any other offer').

findings.name: No student/education program or education license found
findings.detail: Mollie has no student, academic, or education license offer. mollie.com/education returns 404; no education program appears on the official pricing page, the Startup Program page, the developer docs, or in 2025–2026 search coverage of Mollie programs. Mollie's free offers are the free base account/test sandbox, the Startup Program (VC-funded startups), and the €1,000 new-customer promo — none target students, schools, or educational institutions. Individuals (including students without a registered business) cannot open a Mollie account at all, so a 'free dev tier for students' does not exist.
findings.eligibility: n/a — no offer. Developers who are students can only use Mollie's free test sandbox through a registered European/UK business (see free-tier finding).
findings.claim: n/a — nothing to claim; if you need a free sandbox for student projects, use Mollie's test mode via a business account or consider a competitor with a student/dev offer.
findings.expiry: n/a

sunset_notes: No Mollie free offer was sunset or removed in 2025–2026 that I could verify. Changes noted: (1) The Mollie Startup Program tiers currently read €75k/€500k/€1M waived fees — a third-party aggregator (StartupPerks, checked ~2026-08-27) notes a "measured 5x expansion" added on 2026-08-27, implying the tiers were previously much smaller (pre-expansion amounts not stated on the official page, so treat as unconfirmed). (2) The €1,000 new-customer promo exists in Mollie's campaign T&Cs with no stated end date; whether it is still being actively issued to new signups is unconfirmed (page live today, no calendar dates). (3) Mollie's general campaign terms state offers are "subject to change, withdrawal or cancellation at any time". No education/student program existed in 2025–2026 to sunset. Key facts verified today on official pages: no monthly fees / no lock-in, 35+ payment methods included, POS "Pay as you go" at €0/month, and test API keys free with no card required.

findings.name: Contentful Free plan ("Start for free" / Starter Space)
findings.detail: Permanently free platform plan, no credit card. Current limits (official pricing page, Nov 2025 snapshot via search index, corroborated by two 2026 trackers): 10 users, 2 roles (Admin, Editor), 2 locales, 25 content types, 10,000 records total (entries + assets combined), 2 environments, 100K API calls/month, 50 GB CDN asset bandwidth/month, 50 MB asset upload. 'No overages' on the free plan (usage at the cap is blocked/throttled, not billed). One Starter Space included with every plan; cannot be purchased separately; no paid add-ons for extra API calls or bandwidth on free. Community support only. Historically aimed at personal projects, hack weeks, local non-profits; the 2020 FAQ says 'not intended for commercial purposes'. Aims at 'innovation and education' per the FAQ.
findings.eligibility: Anyone: sign up with any email, no credit card required, no .edu required, no region restrictions documented, no application/approval. Students, individual developers and non-profits are the stated audience; commercial use is discouraged (per FAQ).
findings.claim: Step 1: create a free account at contentful.com (email only, 'no credit card required' per get-started page). Step 2: the free Starter Space and free Platform tier are provisioned automatically. No forms, no sales call.
findings.expiry: Indefinite; no expiry or renewal. Monthly API-call/bandwidth quotas reset each month; no overage billing on the free plan.
findings.gotchas: Free tier was CUT sharply in the 2025 platform restructure: API calls 1M→100K/month, CDN 0.1TB (plus 0.75TB Intro Space) → 50GB/month, users 5→10 but roles 4→2. The 'known so far' baseline (20M content API requests/month, 10K assets, 3 authors, 15-day paid trials) matches no documented 2024–2026 official configuration (last documented free-tier API cap was 1M/month). 10,000 records counts entries AND assets together, so the 10K-asset figure is wrong. 2-locale wall: a third language forces the ~$300/mo Lite plan. No workflows on free. Official page could not be read live on 2026-10-22 (site behind Vercel bot-checkpoint, HTTP 429 to automated fetches), so figures rest on the Nov 2025 official-page snapshot plus dev.to (Oct 2026) and Spyingbee (Jun–Aug 2026) corroboration.

findings.name: Time-limited trial of paid plans (reported 14–15 days, no credit card)
findings.detail: Contentful has historically offered a limited trial of its paid plans without a credit card (third-party guide, Nov 2024: 'Contentful also offers a free trial for its basic plan'; the 2020 free-plan FAQ contrasts 'limited, 14-day trials' against the free plan). The 'known so far' note cites 15-day trials of paid plans. The Nov 2025 official pricing-page snapshot shows no trial duration at all — the permanent 'Start for free' tier is now the entry point — so whether a paid-plan trial still exists as of 2026-10-22 is unconfirmed.
findings.eligibility: New customers exploring paid tiers (Lite ~$300/mo, Premium/Enterprise custom); no .edu or region requirement; historically no credit card for the trial itself (a payment method becomes required to stay on a paid plan).
findings.claim: If the trial persists: sign up free, then start a Lite trial from account billing settings or via 'contact sales'. Unverifiable from the public pricing page as of 2026-10-22 (no trial text in the page snapshot; live page was bot-blocked).
findings.expiry: Reported 15 days (older materials say 14 days); then convert to a paid plan or drop back to the free plan.
findings.gotchas: Trial-vs-free gotcha: the free plan is permanent and needs no trial, so the trial only matters for evaluating Lite/Premium. Exact duration (15 vs 14 days) unverified. After trial, Lite is ~$300/mo — a $0→$300 cliff with no mid tier. Adding a card is required to keep a paid trial running past its window.

findings.name: Contentful for Startups (reported ~$1,000 in credits)
findings.detail: Third-party deal aggregators list a 'Contentful Startup Credits: $1,000 in credits' offer (SaaSOffers, labeled 'Verified October 2026', details behind their paywall; StartupFlowAI directory entry: pre-seed/seed stage, global, no stated funding limit, no referral needed). No official program or application page exists on contentful.com, and StartupFlowAI explicitly states 'we have not confirmed a direct application page for this programme yet, so this opens the provider's main site'. SaaSOffers' own FAQ on the same page is internally inconsistent (it claims a 'Community plan' with 25K API calls/month — a figure matching no official source; the free plan is 100K/month), so treat the $1,000 claim as unverified.
findings.eligibility: As reported by aggregators: early-stage startups (pre-seed/seed); SaaSOffers FAQ claims bootstrapped startups without VC funding qualify; no published company-age or funding cap; no .edu requirement. Eligibility caps are unconfirmed by any official source.
findings.claim: Per the aggregators: follow their link to Contentful and create an account; 'apply the credits' via the account. In practice this is likely routed through Contentful sales/partnerships ('check for account credit... negotiate a custom deal', per procurement guides). No public application form found as of 2026-10-22 — verify by contacting Contentful sales before relying on it.
findings.expiry: Unknown. If credits exist, deals of this kind are typically valid ~12 months and unused credits lapse; no official terms are published.
findings.gotchas: Likely a sales-led credit/discount rather than a self-serve public program. Aggregator-sourced amounts and FAQ details are unreliable (contradictory 'Community plan' numbers on the same page). Confirm directly with Contentful sales; do not build a plan around the $1,000 figure.

findings.name: Education / student license: none found — students use the standard free plan
findings.detail: No .edu-eligible license, student discount, or university program was found on contentful.com or in any 2025–2026 report. CostBench (pricing verified Aug 2026) says of Contentful: 'No published discount programs' — its nonprofit/education/startup sections are generic boilerplate with unverified terms. The official free-plan FAQ states the free plan is offered because Contentful believes in 'supporting innovation and education', which makes the standard no-credit-card free plan the de facto student offer.
findings.eligibility: Open to everyone including students and educators; no .edu email required; no enrollment proof; no region limits documented.
findings.claim: No separate claim process: create a free Contentful account with any email (no credit card) and use the free Starter Space. For institutional/enterprise education deployments, contact sales.
findings.expiry: Indefinite, same as the free plan; nothing to renew.
findings.gotchas: Absence of a published program does not prove none exists privately — institutions should still ask sales. The free-plan FAQ wording ('not intended for commercial purposes', 2020) suggests monetized student startups outgrow it quickly. Any institutional license would likely be sales-negotiated, not public.

sunset_notes: 2025–2026 changes: (1) The free plan was materially CUT in the 2025 "Platform" pricing restructure documented on the official page from Nov 2025: API calls 1M→100K/month, CDN 0.1TB platform + 0.75TB Intro Space→50GB/month, users 5→10, roles 4→2, content types 25 and 10K records retained in the included Starter Space. (2) "Basic" was renamed "Lite" (~$300/mo: 20 users, 3 roles, 3 locales, 1M API calls, 100GB CDN) and an explicit "Enterprise" custom tier plus "Personalization" tiers appeared in 2026 (Spyingbee, Jun–Aug 2026; dev.to, Jul/Oct 2026). (3) The "15-day trials of paid plans" from the baseline note are no longer advertised on the current pricing page (no trial text in the Nov 2025 snapshot; the permanent free plan is the entry point) — trial existence unconfirmed. (4) The baseline "20M content API requests/month, 10K assets, 3 authors" matches no documented 2024–2026 official configuration; the last documented free-plan API cap was 1M/month (2024–25 guides), and the current official cap is 100K/month. (5) No education license or public startup program was found; the only startup-credit lead (~$1,000) exists solely in third-party deal aggregators with no confirmed official application page. Caveat: contentful.com pages were not readable live on 2026-10-22 (Vercel security checkpoint returned HTTP 429 to all automated fetches; WebSearch budget exhausted), so confidence levels reflect search-indexed official-page snapshots plus independent 2026 trackers rather than a same-day read of the official pages. findings.name: Free tier: Wise API sandbox with pre-funded £1,000,000 test credit
findings.detail: Sandbox is a fully free test environment of the Wise Business/Personal API. Every new sandbox account is pre-funded with 1,000,000 GBP of test credit (confirmed in the official Help Centre article; the API page says 'Start building for free today' and 'It only takes a few minutes to get a sandbox account'). V2 sandbox UI is at https://wise-sandbox.com with API base URLs https://api.wise-sandbox.com (TLS) or https://api-mtls.wise-sandbox.com (mTLS). Personal API tokens can be created for free from Settings → API tokens; 2-step verification is required and token creation is web-only. No per-call API pricing exists; there is no subscription. The sandbox also includes a Simulation API for testing money-movement flows and webhooks. No student, .edu, or startup criteria apply — it is open to anyone.
findings.eligibility: Open to everyone (personal or business), any region, with just an email address. No .edu email required, no credit card, no identity verification, no startup age/funding cap. Caveat: Wise's most stable sandbox test flows are UK regions (UK personal, UK sole-trader business) with GBP, USD, EUR; other currencies/regions may misbehave. Sandbox does not support real money, real financial controls, or load/performance testing.
findings.claim: 1) Register a free sandbox account at the sandbox URL (email + password; phone verification code in sandbox is the literal 111111; your real Wise account will NOT work in sandbox). 2) Log into the sandbox, go to Settings → API tokens, and add a new personal token (2FA must be set up; web only). 3) Build against api.wise-sandbox.com. 4) When ready, open a separate verified Wise Business account and create live API tokens from its Settings page.
findings.expiry: No published expiry for sandbox accounts. IMPORTANT: Sandbox V1 (sandbox.transferwise.tech / sandbox.wise.tech) is deprecated June 30, 2026; use V2 (wise-sandbox.com). Test data created after April 1, 2025 was not migrated to V2 and must be re-seeded; V1 tokens/credentials created after April 1, 2025 do not work in V2 (request new ones via api@wise.com or your delivery contact).
findings.gotchas: Test credit is virtual only — it is not withdrawable, spendable, or convertible to a live balance. Sandbox has higher latency than production and no load-testing support. Do not put real personal data in sandbox (weaker access controls). Going live is a separate step requiring a verified Wise Business account; in the US a one-time account setup fee (e.g., $31) can apply to unlock account details. Personal API tokens have endpoint limitations: in EU/UK, PSD2 means you cannot fund transfers or view balance statements via API with a personal token. API access is per-account; OAuth 2.0 partner credentials (client ID/secret) are only issued to Wise Platform partners.

findings.name: Live Wise API at no extra API fee (Wise Business account, personal token)
findings.detail: Official docs FAQ: 'For business accounts accessing the Wise API with a personal token, there are no additional charges to use the available API features. For these accounts, Wise applies the regular pricing system for customers.' The account itself is free to register and free to hold money (pricing page lists no monthly fee). What you pay is the regular per-transfer fee: sending/converting 'from 0.23%' (route-specific fixed + %; e.g., wire transfers from $1.13; receiving USD wires fixed $6.11, GBP $2.16, EUR 2.39 per payment). Technical support for business-account API users is free via api@wise.com (60-minute response target); API status at status.wise.com. Wise US is a FinCen-registered MSB, not an FDIC bank.
findings.eligibility: Anyone with a verified Wise Business account in a supported region; no student or startup-specific gate, no .edu requirement, no credit card required for the account (funding happens via bank transfer/card per normal Wise rules). Large enterprises and partner integrations instead use OAuth 2.0 with partner-issued client credentials. Personal tokens are meant for small-business users automating their own account.
findings.claim: 1) Open a Wise Business account (free; 'Register for a Wise account: Free', 'Holding money: Free'; US one-time account setup fee of e.g. $31 may apply to unlock account details). 2) Verify the account and enable 2-step verification. 3) Settings → API tokens → Add new token; pass it as Authorization: Bearer against https://api.wise.com (mTLS: https://api-mtls.transferwise.com). 4) Fund transfers through normal Wise channels and pay route-specific fees. For partner/enterprise OAuth access, email api@wise.com.
findings.expiry: No published expiry or sunset for API access. Sandbox-side change to note: V1 sandbox deprecates June 30, 2026 (see other finding). No 2025–2026 removal of free API access found.
findings.gotchas: 'Free API' ≠ 'free transfers' — real money movement costs the normal route fee (from ~0.23% + fixed) and, in the US, a one-time ~$31 account setup fee can apply. Personal-token endpoint limits: EU/UK cannot fund transfers or view balance statements via API (PSD2); payment links and 'receive money in your checkout' are NOT supported by the public API. No load/performance testing on sandbox. The pricing FAQ text was confirmed via an official docs search snippet; the docs page fetch itself truncated, so treat exact wording as medium-confidence.

findings.name: Wise for Startups — startup solution page (no free startup credits or grants)
findings.detail: The official 'Wise for Startups' page markets the standard Wise Business account to founders: 'Extend your runway with Wise', receive investor funding in local currencies, Swift receiving in 22+ currencies, 'Earn 3.39% (variable) APY on USD' with passthrough FDIC insurance up to $250,000 on USD/GBP/EUR balances, 'fees from 0.33%', volume pricing 'Get discounts on monthly volumes over 25,000 USD or equivalent' (worked example: $88.83 fee less a $4.91 volume discount), and claims '77% of transfers arrive in seconds' (accurate as of Q1 2026). It bundles API integrations ('Explore API integrations') and accounting integrations (Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, Zoho, FreeAgent, Oracle NetSuite), plus an expert account manager and 24/7 support for eligible businesses. There is NO named startup program, no grant, no free-transfer allocation, and no startup-exclusive fee waiver anywhere on the page — a startup gets exactly the same free account + free-API-access terms as any other business.
findings.eligibility: Open to startups generally ('from seed-stage startups to public companies'); no startup-age threshold, funding cap, or revenue limit is stated. Availability is region-dependent ('Certain features may not be available in all regions and plans'). Not a student offer; no .edu requirement; no credit card requirement.
findings.claim: Sign up for a Wise Business account via the 'Sign up in minutes' CTA on the startups page, or 'Contact sales' for an account manager. No separate application, cap, or verification of startup status.
findings.expiry: No sunset date published. Figures are dated: APY 'true as of 17 December 2025'; transfer-speed stat 'Accurate as of Q1, 2026' — treat APY as variable and re-check. The volume discount is a standing program, not a trial.
findings.gotchas: The only 'discount' on the page is the >$25,000 USD/month volume discount — that is not a free offer and requires significant volume. A one-time account setup fee (e.g., $31 in the US) may apply. APY is variable, not guaranteed. This is a marketing solution page, not a funding program: if you were expecting startup API credits or a founder grant, Wise does not offer one.

sunset_notes: No student/education offer exists at Wise: no .edu discount, no student pricing, and no education license was found on any official Wise page (the 'Education platforms' label on the site refers to edtech companies using the Wise Platform API, not consumer student offers). Third-party coupon aggregators (e.g., wise.coupon.ai) claim a 'Student Discount on International Payments' requiring student-status verification — this is not an official Wise program and could not be verified from any Wise property, so treat it as unverified noise. No startup-specific free credits, grants, or trials were found; 'Wise for Startups' (wise.com/us/business/solutions/startups) is a marketing page with the standard free account + free API access plus a volume-only discount. 2025–2026 changes that DO exist: (1) Sandbox V1 (sandbox.transferwise.tech / sandbox.wise.tech) was deprecated June 30, 2026 in favor of V2 (wise-sandbox.com); V1 test data created after April 1, 2025 was not migrated and V1 tokens created after that date do not work in V2. (2) The US one-time account setup fee (~$31 to unlock account details) appears on current pricing pages — a newer cost item not present on older free-account marketing. (3) No sunset or material change to free API access or the £1,000,000 pre-funded sandbox test credit was found. Method note: the WebSearch budget for this session was exhausted mid-run after a handful of searches, so negative findings ('no student offer', 'no startup grant') rest on one search round plus today's reads of the official API, pricing, startups, Help Centre, and docs pages; if exhaustive negative proof is needed, re-run the searches.

No offers found to be sunset on the pages read today. (1) No public student/.edu education-license program found: https://www.zoho.com/education/, /students/, /academic/ all 404, and the CRM pricing page carries no student offer — Zoho's education angle today is Zoho University (free courses/exams, open to all, not a .edu license), whose site (zohouniversity.com) was unreadable today due to a TLS cert mismatch, so its current details are unverified. (2) Zoho for Startups is active but region-gated (incl. India, UK, US-adjacent list; no US on the list as fetched today) and enabler-gated; credit amounts are not published on the page. (3) Verification caveat: WebSearch budget was exhausted mid-task, so 2025-2026 change checks relied on today's official pages only; the CRM paid-trial duration is not stated on zoho.com/crm/pricing.html (sibling Zoho pages confirm 14-15 day, no-CC trial pattern).

findings.name: Zoho CRM Free Edition (free forever, 3 users)
findings.detail: Forever free Zoho CRM. Limits: up to 3 users; 5,000 API calls/day; up to 10 custom email templates; free data export up to 10 times; spreadsheet import free. Includes contact management, follow-up reminders, workflow automation, tasks/meetings/call tracking, standard reports, mobile app. Excluded: mass email, forecasting, CPQ, custom portals, reporting hierarchy, sandbox, field-level encryption, AI agents (paid tiers only). No billing/credit-card for the free plan. No region limit stated.
findings.eligibility: Anyone; up to 3 users; no .edu, no startup cap, no credit card; appears available in all Zoho-supported regions.
findings.claim: Go to zoho.com/crm/pricing.html, click 'Start Free' / create account on the Free edition; no payment method entered.
findings.expiry: Free forever; no renewal. Limits (3 users, 5,000 API calls/day, 10 email templates, 10 exports) are the permanent caps.
findings.gotchas: No storage cap or automation-count cap is published; data export capped at 10 times total; API quota 5,000 calls/day is lower than Standard paid (15,000/day) — API workloads will hit the ceiling; paid-tier features are hard-gated; local taxes added to any later paid upgrade.

findings.name: Zoho for Startups — Zoho Wallet Credits program (startup program)
findings.detail: Early-stage startups get Zoho Wallet Credits to trial Zoho's 55+ app SaaS suite (any Zoho app/suite incl. Zoho One, Workplace Stage 1, People Plus; also upgrades, add-ons, monthly renewals; Workplace/Mail excluded from Stage-2 credits). Two stages: base credit after validation + extra credit if the startup hosts its domain with Zoho within 15 days. Credits valid 360 days, then balance resets to 0, no extensions; one-time benefit; not transferable, not refundable. Amounts in $ are not published on the page (left blank as fetched today).
findings.eligibility: Must fit Startup India definition; registered with a collaborating ecosystem enabler (incubator/accelerator/coworking space) OR DPIIT/Startup India recognition; must be new/free Zoho user with no paid-subscription history; MSMEs excluded; one claim only. Limited to startups in ~24 countries (India, UK, Australia, Germany, France, Spain, UAE, Brazil, Egypt, Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana-listed neighbors, etc.).
findings.claim: 1) Create Zoho account with the org's primary admin email. 2) Register at the Zoho founders-registration page, selecting your associated startup hub. 3) Validation takes 5-7 business days. 4) Credits land in Zoho Wallet; follow the confirmation email to enable domain hosting for Stage-2 credits within 15 days.
findings.expiry: Credits expire 360 days from deposit, no extension; program is one-time per startup.
findings.gotchas: Credit values are undisclosed on the public page (verify at registration); strictly gated on enabler/DPIIT association — no open application; deleting the account zeroes the balance; weekdays-only classic email support and free English consultation only; training via paid Zoho Partners; no US in the country list as fetched today (confirm current list on the page).

findings.name: Zoho CRM paid-edition free trial (Standard/Professional/Enterprise/Ultimate, Bigin, CRM Plus)
findings.detail: Free trial of all paid editions via 'START FREE TRIAL' CTAs on the pricing page; 'flexible free trial' signup; no trial duration in days and no credit-card statement appears anywhere on zoho.com/crm/pricing.html as fetched today. Trial signups for free editions elsewhere in Zoho use email only (no billing).
findings.eligibility: Anyone signing up; new accounts; no .edu requirement; credit card not required for trial sign-up on Zoho product pages (email/password only).
findings.claim: On zoho.com/crm/pricing.html click 'Start free trial' for the chosen paid edition and complete email sign-up; downgrade/choice of plan available during signup.
findings.expiry: Trial window not stated on the CRM page (sibling Zoho products state 14-day Books/Cliq trials and 15-day Desk/Creator trials); at trial end you are charged only if you convert to paid.
findings.gotchas: Trial-vs-free: after the trial you must actively subscribe (paid) — unlike Desk/Creator, Zoho CRM has no public auto-downgrade-to-Free path stated on the pricing page; free edition remains available separately; duration unverified on official page today (medium confidence).

findings.name: Zoho Desk Free Edition (3 users, free forever)
findings.detail: Zoho Desk Free: 3 user licenses, easy email ticketing out of the box, 'Free Forever' (₹2,600 crossed out in INR locale). No numeric caps on tickets/storage stated on the page. 15-day free trial of any paid plan (Standard/Professional/Enterprise), sign-up explicitly 'without ever providing a credit card'; when a paid plan's trial ends, the account auto-downgrades to the Free plan.
findings.eligibility: Anyone; 3 users; no .edu, no credit card, no region limit stated.
findings.claim: Sign up at desk.zoho.com / zoho.com/desk/pricing.html Free edition; or start a 15-day paid-plan trial without a card.
findings.expiry: Free forever. Paid-plan trial: 15 days then automatic downgrade to Free (data retained, no charge).
findings.gotchas: No light-user seats, no automation/AI/multi-department/SLA features in Free; Standard starts at 5 users; annual billing saves up to 34% vs monthly if you upgrade.

findings.name: Zoho Creator Free Edition (1 app, free forever)
findings.detail: Zoho Creator Free: one custom app for low-code app building; basic app-building needs supported; standing free tier per FAQ. Granular caps (users, storage, API-call/cloud-function counts) are not on the pricing page — they live in the linked full feature-comparison. 15-day fully-featured trial of Standard/Professional/Enterprise, 'No credit card' listed as a trial condition; default signup lands in the Professional trial; after 15 days the account moves to the Free plan.
findings.eligibility: Anyone; individuals/small teams; no .edu, no credit card; region not limited on the page.
findings.claim: Sign up at creator.zoho.com / zoho.com/creator/pricing.html; choose Free (or start the 15-day trial without a card).
findings.expiry: Free forever; trial auto-downgrades to Free at day 15.
findings.gotchas: Free is single-app only; user/storage/API limits undisclosed on the pricing page — check the feature-comparison link before relying on Free for API workloads; yearly billing >30% cheaper if you upgrade.

findings.name: Zoho Analytics Free Plan (2 users, 10K rows, free forever)
findings.detail: Zoho Analytics Free: 2 users, 10K rows, 5 workspaces, unlimited reports and dashboards; 'No credit card required' listed among sign-up conditions; FAQ confirms the Free Plan continues 'always' without upgrading. Not included: Streaming Datasets, Email Import, Live Connect, Data Snapshots, Ask Zia AI Agent, Auto ML, Code Studio, premium connectors, data alerts, Zoho Flow integration, access logs, backup/restore.
findings.eligibility: Anyone; 2 users; no .edu, no credit card; region not limited on the page.
findings.claim: Sign up at zoho.com/analytics/pricing.html 'GET STARTED NOW' (routes to Free plan signup, no trial needed).
findings.expiry: Free forever; no renewal; row cap (10K) is the binding constraint, not time.
findings.gotchas: Trial-vs-free: no trial conversion trap — it is a standing tier; 10K-row limit rules out most production BI; per-plan prices/rows for paid tiers unchanged (check page for current pricing).

findings.name: Zoho Projects Free Plan (5 users, 3 projects, 5 GB, free forever)
findings.detail: Zoho Projects Free: up to 5 users, 3 projects, 5 GB storage, 50 workflow actions/executions per month; includes subtasks, Whiteboard, iOS/Android apps, Google & Office 365 integration, Zoho MCP Server access. 'We do not ask for your credit card information when you sign up.' 15-day free trial of Premium/Enterprise/Ultimate, no credit card.
findings.eligibility: Anyone; 5 users / 3 projects; no .edu, no credit card; region not limited on the page.
findings.claim: Sign up at zoho.com/projects/pricing.html Free plan; or start a 15-day paid-plan trial without a card.
findings.expiry: Free forever (no expiration stated); trial ends at 15 days and converts only if you purchase.
findings.gotchas: 50 workflow executions/month is tight for automation-heavy teams; project cap of 3 blocks small agencies; MCP Server access is a genuinely useful free developer perk.

findings.name: Zoho Writer Free (free word processor, no credit card)
findings.detail: Zoho Writer is a free word processor: 'unrestricted access to all its features as soon as you sign up'; no credit card mentioned. Document automation: unlimited template creation for free; generating documents consumes credits — a free monthly automation-credit allotment is included, with paid add-on credits for extra volume. Also free: grammar checker, plagiarism checker, document translation tool, online PDF editor. Exact storage quota not stated on the landing page (pricing page /writer/pricing.html is the source of record).
findings.eligibility: Anyone; no .edu, no credit card; region not limited on the page.
findings.claim: Sign up via writer.zoho.com 'Start writing now' (/writer/signup.html) or the free demo link.
findings.expiry: Free with no stated expiration; automation free-credit allotment renews monthly; template creation unlimited.
findings.gotchas: Trial-vs-free: core writing is free (not a trial); but bulk document generation is credit-metered — free monthly credits can run out; storage cap not disclosed on the page fetched today (check /writer/pricing.html).

findings.name: Zoho Books Free Plan (1 user + 1 accountant, $50K revenue cap)
findings.detail: Zoho Books Free: $0/org/month, indefinitely provided your revenue for the financial year does not exceed 50K USD. 1 user + 1 accountant; up to 1,000 invoices/year and 1,000 expenses/year; 5 scheduled reports; 100K-record async report exports; 50 receipt autoscans/month. No credit card ('we don't store your credit card information'). 14-day free trial of paid tiers (Standard-Elite/Ultimate), no credit card mentioned as required. Email support Mon-Fri 9am-7pm.
findings.eligibility: Startups/small businesses worldwide; hard cap: revenue under 50K USD for the financial year or the Free plan no longer applies; no .edu needed.
findings.claim: Sign up at zoho.com/books/pricing.html Free plan (company name, email, phone, password — no card).
findings.expiry: Free indefinitely while revenue stays under 50K USD per financial year; the cap is annual, so it effectively renews every fiscal year based on revenue.
findings.gotchas: Revenue cap is the gotcha: cross 50K USD and you must move to paid; 1-user + 1-accountant is very restrictive for teams; add-ons unsupported except document autoscans; 14-day (not 15-day) paid trial.

findings.name: Zoho Cliq Free Plan (10K searchable messages, 60-min meetings, 100 GB, free forever)
findings.detail: Zoho Cliq Free: permanent Free tier for any team size (no user cap stated on the page); 10,000 searchable messages; 100-participant groups/channels (no external channels); meetings up to 100 participants, 60 min max; audio/video messages and screen recordings capped at 5 min; 100 GB org-level file storage; 24-hour delete window. Excluded: call recording, team channels, roles/permissions, custom domain/email, DLP, eDiscovery, branded meetings, live events. 14-day trial of Standard/Professional/Enterprise, 'Start free trial' buttons; unsubscribing at trial end downgrades to Free with data retained.
findings.eligibility: Anyone; all team sizes; no .edu, no credit card.
findings.claim: Sign up at zoho.com/cliq/pricing.html 'Try Now' on the Free tier; no trial conversion for the free tier itself.
findings.expiry: Free forever; 14-day paid trial expires unless you purchase.
findings.gotchas: Trial-vs-free: the Free tier is a real standing plan, not a trial; 10K searchable-message cap and no external channels matter for customer-facing use; Professional/Enterprise require minimum 10 users.

findings.name: Zoho Mail 'Free Forever' plan (5 users, 5 GB/user)
findings.detail: Zoho Mail Free Forever: up to 5 users on one custom domain ('from the 6th user all users enter a paid plan'); 5 GB mail storage per user; IMAP/POP/Active Sync NOT included; mobile app included; bundles free editions of Mail, Calendar, ToDo, Cliq (free: 5-min A/V messages, 10K searchable messages, 100-participant channels, 60-min meetings, 100 GB org storage) and eWidget & Developer Space. No credit card. Footnote: '*Available only in select data centers.' 15-day trial of Mail Premium, no credit card.
findings.eligibility: Anyone; 5 users/custom domain; no .edu, no credit card; availability limited to select Zoho data centers (not a single-region lock, e.g., India-only).
findings.claim: Sign up at zoho.com/mail/pricing.html Free plan (email/password only).
findings.expiry: Free forever; 15-day Mail Premium trial expires at day 15 unless purchased.
findings.gotchas: No IMAP/POP/ActiveSync is the big one — desktop mail clients won't work on Free; 'select data centers' footnote means some regions can't claim it; 6th user forces everyone to paid; mixed paid/free yearly plans only allowed on yearly billing.

findings.name: Zoho University (free courses & certification exams, open to all — not a .edu license)
findings.detail: Zoho's free e-learning program: courses and certification exams for Zoho products, open to anyone (no .edu email required) with most content free; some certification exams historically carry a fee. Treat as free learning, not a free software license.
findings.eligibility: Open to all (students and professionals); no .edu requirement; no funding caps.
findings.claim: Register at Zoho University (zoho.com/university redirects to zohouniversity.com); enroll in courses; take exams where free.
findings.expiry: n/a (not a time-boxed offer).
findings.gotchas: The zohouniversity.com site was unreadable today due to a TLS certificate mismatch, so the current free/fees split for exams could not be verified on the official page today; confirm fees per exam before relying on 'free'.

findings.name: Free test mode / sandbox (fake money)
findings.detail: Moov gives every new account a free test environment: sign up and you start in test mode with pre-loaded sample account and business data; requested capabilities are auto-marked verified (no real KYC/KYB checks); transfers automatically complete; micro-deposit bank verification is simulated (enter $0.00 to succeed). No published transaction-count cap, no time limit, no credit card needed to sign up or build. Only fake money moves — real-money movement requires contacting Moov to pass verification and select a fee plan (standard plan: $500 monthly minimum, Interchange++ + 0.60% + 15c card, ACH same-day 40c, wallet 50c/mo — confirming the known baseline as of today).
findings.eligibility: Anyone who signs up at dashboard.moov.io; no .edu email, no startup-age or funding cap, no credit card. Platform is US-centric (US ACH, TCH RTP, FedNow, card rails).
findings.claim: 1) Create a Moov account (sign up) -> 2) you land in test mode with sample data pre-loaded -> 3) create a test-mode API key (named for test/CI use) and develop against the API/SDK in a no-risk environment -> 4) to move real money, contact Moov to complete verification and choose a fee plan.
findings.expiry: No stated expiry or renewal for test mode; no published data-retention limit. Test mode becomes moot once you move to production (a separate verified account).
findings.gotchas: No live money movement in test mode — it is a dev sandbox, not a free production tier. $0 spend does not survive production: standard pricing starts at a $500 monthly minimum. Test-mode feature set lags (e.g., 'simulated failed or reversed transfers' was still 'coming soon' per the 2021 launch post). API 'latest' version is deprecated; pin v2026.07.00. Free ACH micro-deposits are free even in production, but instant bank validation is 75c/attempt and third-party bank validation $1.50/attempt.

findings.name: Payment links / branded receipts / transaction monitoring fees waived
findings.detail: On the pricing page, payment links, branded receipts, and transaction monitoring are marked 'Included' but the fine print says 'Waived for accounts with standard pricing' — i.e., the fees are waived only for accounts already on the $500/month-minimum standard plan. This is a fee waiver inside a paid plan, NOT a standalone free offer, and is not targeted at students or startups.
findings.eligibility: Accounts on Moov's standard pricing plan (pay-as-you-go, $500 monthly minimum) only. No student or startup-specific eligibility; no .edu requirement.
findings.claim: Nothing to claim separately: sign up, move to production, and select the standard fee plan; payment-link and receipt fees are then waived.
findings.expiry: Recurring with the standard plan; waiver lasts as long as the account is on standard pricing.
findings.gotchas: Do not mistake 'free payment links' for a free plan — the waiver is relative to a paid $500/mo minimum. Same-day ACH (40c), wallet (50c/mo) and card (Interchange++ + 0.60% + 15c) fees still apply on top of the minimum.

sunset_notes: No sunset or material 2025-2026 change found: Moov has no startup program, no trial-credit offer, and no education/.edu license. Verified today: moov.io/pricing/ still shows the $500 monthly minimum (matching the known baseline; page copyright 2026); https://www.moov.io/startup/ and https://www.moov.io/education/ both return 404; the 2025-2026 blog posts (P2P network Sep 2026, tap-to-get-paid May 2026, payment-links speed Feb 2026, multiple wallets Oct 2025, Go generics Jun 2025) contain no pricing, free-tier, startup, or education announcements. 'Moov Africa Startup Challenge 2022' (FCFA subsidies, Burkina Faso) belongs to an unrelated company (Moov Africa, a West-African mobile-money provider) and is not moov.io. The only genuine free items are the free test/sandbox environment (find above) and fee waivers that are meaningful only inside the paid standard plan. No sunset notes because there were no documented programs to sunset.

provider: Lemon Squeezy (Stripe) — Payments & Fintech Dev Tools

findings.name: Standard free tier: $0/mo base, pay-per-transaction pricing (perpetual, no card)
findings.detail: Ecommerce features cost $0/mo — 'no monthly charges for ecommerce features'; only a per-transaction fee of 5% + 50¢ applies. Includes API access, license-key management, store builder, subscriptions, discounts, fraud AI, analytics; VAT/sales-tax collection and filing included because Lemon Squeezy is your merchant of record. Signing up is free with no card, no trial and no contract ('free to start — no trial, no contract, no risk'). This is the de-facto program for startups/solopreneurs: no funding cap, no age cap, perpetual.
findings.eligibility: Global (no region limit stated for signup). No credit card required to sign up; no .edu, no startup-age or funding cap. Payouts: bank wire or PayPal, twice monthly, 200+ countries supported. As of Jan 2026 the successor product Stripe Managed Payments supports merchants in 35+ countries, so effective availability may narrow by merchant country.
findings.claim: Create an account at app.lemonsqueezy.com/register (no card), add a product, and you can sell immediately in test mode; real payments require your new store application to be approved (follow-up questions may be asked). No application form or approval is needed for the free tier itself.
findings.expiry: Perpetual. There is no trial period and nothing auto-expires; the $0/mo base is a permanent pricing model, not a promotion.
findings.gotchas: True per-transaction cost exceeds 5% + 50¢ in common cases: +1.5% on international (non-US) card transactions, +1.5% on PayPal transactions, +0.5% on subscription payments, +1% per payout to non-US Stripe banks, +$0.50 per US PayPal payout and 3% (capped $30) per non-US PayPal payout; +5% extra on recovered abandoned-cart payments, +3% merchant affiliate fee, +2% affiliate payouts. Email marketing beyond 500 subscribers costs money (pricing scales with subscriber count; only 'free up to 500' is published on the pricing page). Refunds/chargebacks may carry separate fees. Lemon Squeezy is merchant of record, so it withholds/reserves funds as it deems needed — check payout hold terms in-app. Some payment methods 'may be subject to additional fees'.

findings.name: Buildspace program: 0% fees for 30 days (closest thing to a student/education offer)
findings.detail: Participants of Buildspace 'Nights & Weekends' and the buildspace school get 0% platform fees for 30 days on a new Lemon Squeezy store — 'After your first 30 days, we'll provide an all-inclusive pricing of 5% + 50¢ per transaction'. This is the only education-adjacent offer found on the official site; there is no .edu discount or separate student license (lemonsqueezy.com/education and /students are 404).
findings.eligibility: Must be a participant of a Buildspace course/Nights & Weekends event (learners, not companies — no funding cap, no corporate age limit; no .edu requirement stated). Global, subject to Lemon Squeezy approving the store. Solo builders eligible.
findings.claim: Step 1 — create your Lemon Squeezy store (free, no card). Step 2 — go to lemonsqueezy.com/buildspace and enter your buildspace code. Step 3 — complete the form (requires your store URL from Store Settings). Step 4 — discount applied manually within 3 working days. Test mode is available immediately; real payments may require follow-up questions before approval.
findings.expiry: 30 days of 0% fees, then standard 5% + 50¢ permanently. Offer itself has no stated sunset date as of 2026-10-22.
findings.gotchas: Applied manually — allow 3 working days, longer for new store approval; not a generic 'student discount' you can claim with a .edu address. 0% fee refers to the Lemon Squeezy platform fee only — underlying Stripe processing is bundled into that fee, but surcharge structure post-promo is as in the main fee schedule.

findings.name: Migration offer: 0% fees for first 30 days, up to $10,000 in sales
findings.detail: Switchers from other platforms (page explicitly references Gumroad) get 0% fees for their first 30 days on Lemon Squeezy, 'up to $10,000 in sales'. Migration of existing store data is done manually by Lemon Squeezy so data moves correctly. Free to sign up, no card required ('You can sign up for Lemon Squeezy and take it for a test drive for free — no strings attached, no card required').
findings.eligibility: Any seller switching from another platform; no funding/age cap, no card required, no .edu. Global; store approval by Lemon Squeezy still applies. Open offer (not invite-only) with a claim form.
findings.claim: Step 1 — set up your Lemon Squeezy store and follow their migration instructions. Step 2 — complete the form at lemonsqueezy.com/migration-offer. Migrations are processed manually: allow 2–4 working days for follow-up, after which the 0%-for-30-days offer is applied.
findings.expiry: 0% fees apply for 30 days and only to the first $10,000 in sales; afterwards standard 5% + 50¢. No sunset date published as of 2026-10-22.
findings.gotchas: Manual processing means the promo may not start on day one; the $10,000 sales cap makes it effectively a small-business migration incentive, not a permanent discount. 'Free migration' + free signup still leaves the surcharge structure (international +1.5%, PayPal +1.5%, subscription +0.5%, payout fees) once the 30 days end.

findings.name: Startup program (credits): NOT officially published — unconfirmed third-party listings only
findings.detail: There is no official Lemon Squeezy startup program or free-credits page. /startups returns 404, and no startup-program or credits link exists in the site's navigation. Third-party directories list one: startupflowai.com describes 'Lemon Squeezy (Stripe) startup credits' for pre-seed/seed, global, 'no referral', 'last verified 28 Sep 2026', but admits it has 'not confirmed a direct application page'; perkbook.co lists 'Lemon for Startups' as 'Program not yet confirmed / No active offer is currently published'. The only verifiable 'startup offer' is the perpetual free tier ($0/mo, no card) plus the two 0%-for-30-days promos above.
findings.eligibility: Unknown — no official criteria (stage caps, funding caps, country limits, or application form found on lemonsqueezy.com or stripe.com as of 2026-10-22).
findings.claim: No claimable official program found. If a Stripe-side startup program exists post-acquisition, it would live under Stripe (stripe.com), not on Lemon Squeezy's site; nothing published on lemonsqueezy.com directs startups to one. Do not count on credits.
findings.expiry: N/A — no published offer to expire.
findings.gotchas: Treat all directory claims (StartupFlow AI, PerkBook, Drifting Desk) as unverified — none link an official application page. The safe, verifiable startup offer is the perpetual free tier + 0%-for-30-day promos (Buildspace, migration).

sunset_notes: No free offer was sunset in 2025–2026; the $0/mo + 5%+50¢ model and both 0%-for-30-day promos (Buildspace, migration) were still live on the official site when fetched 2026-10-22. However, there is a material structural change to flag: Stripe completed its acquisition of Lemon Squeezy in July 2024 (entity now 'Sold through Link, LLC f/k/a Lemon Squeezy LLC'), and Lemon Squeezy's own 2026 update blog post (Jan 28, 2026, lemonsqueezy.com/blog/2026-update) states the team is building Stripe Managed Payments and that the entire Lemon Squeezy user base is expected to migrate to it, with a public (no-invite) sign-up 'very soon'. Consequences: (1) Merchant availability for Managed Payments is currently 35+ countries (vs 200+ payout countries today), so the effective footprint of any free offer may narrow by country over time; sellers outside Stripe-supported countries are being pointed to Stripe Atlas to incorporate a US entity. (2) Farr acknowledged 'slower support responses and less frequent product updates' during the transition, so expect promo pages (buildspace, migration) to lose maintenance. (3) No fee-schedule change, program sunset, or new discount was announced — 5% + 50¢ remains the published rate. Note on method: the shared session web-search budget was exhausted before finishing; verification was done by direct fetch of official Lemon Squeezy pages (pricing, buildspace, migration-offer, docs fees, 2026 blog, homepage) on 2026-10-22.

findings.name: Autodesk Education Plan — free 1-year professional licenses for students
findings.detail: Free one-year, single-user access to 75+ professional products (AutoCAD incl. LT/toolsets, Revit, Maya, 3ds Max, Fusion, Inventor, Civil 3D, Alias, Arnold, Flow Studio, Tinkercad, etc.) with the SAME features/functionality as paid subscriptions (not a reduced trial). Access includes current version plus up to 3 prior versions where available; English (some titles in more languages). Install on up to 3 devices. No credit card required — eligibility is verified via SheerID (proof of enrollment). Cloud SaaS services (rendering, simulation, Autodesk Drive storage) are included but users who regularly consume beyond 'market average' may face restrictions that can change without notice. Autodesk Flow Studio requires post-secondary students age 18+.
findings.eligibility: Students enrolled at a qualified (government-accredited) educational institution — middle/high schools, junior colleges, universities, technical schools; meets minimum age requirement. Also eligible: homeschooled students (documented membership in a nationally recognized homeschooling body), students doing thesis/master's work, apprentices (Austria, Germany, Switzerland, UK only), registered participants in Autodesk-sponsored competitions. Typically verified with a school-provided (.edu or equivalent) email + SheerID verification; 'most educational institutions worldwide qualify' except countries under US trade embargo. Graduates lose eligibility but keep the account (and can buy paid licenses); school email can be changed if not using SSO. Minimum age: required per TOU (13+, per Autodesk account terms).
findings.claim: 1) Create/complete an Autodesk account at autodesk.com/education/edu-software (or get assigned a product by a teacher via institution account). 2) Confirm eligibility on the Education Products page using your school-provided email (SheerID may ask for proof of enrollment). 3) Click 'Complete Account Setup' from the confirmation email. 4) Download/install from the Autodesk Account 'All Products and Services' page; sign in to start. Alt path: educator's institution account assigns products — students skip individual verification but still need their own account.
findings.expiry: 1-year term; renewable annually while eligibility (enrollment) continues. Autodesk emails a reminder 30 days before expiration; missing the renewal forces a full restart of access and any subscriptions, even for already-installed products. Check expiration on the Education Products page banner.
findings.gotchas: NOT trial-vs-free confusion: this is the full professional product, but licensed for EDUCATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY — no commercial, professional, or for-profit work; also excluded: campus facilities design and commercially affiliated research. Cloud add-ons (rendering/simulation/storage) can be throttled for heavy users. SheerID profile details can't be changed after submission — keep them matching school records. Verification repeats every year. From Aug 7, 2026 education accounts must use SSO (school credentials) instead of standalone Autodesk passwords. Output/work may not be used commercially even with free tools. US trade-embargoed countries excluded (export compliance).

findings.name: Autodesk Education Plan — educators and qualified institutions (free classroom/lab licenses)
findings.detail: Free 1-year, renewable access for educators (employees/independent contractors whose primary purpose is teaching enrolled students at a qualified institution). An educator creates an Autodesk account FOR THE INSTITUTION and can assign/unassign products to up to 250 students per product; assigned students don't re-verify (eligibility inherits from the educator) but each still needs their own account. Institutions also get web services like Fusion for labs.
findings.eligibility: Employees or contractors of accredited middle/high schools, junior colleges, universities, technical schools, or recognized homeschool bodies. NOT eligible: non-accredited institutions, training centers, churches, hospitals/health-care systems, public libraries, research labs, retraining programs; Autodesk Certified Instructors at ATC partners get genuine ATC licenses instead. Most countries qualify except US trade-embargoed countries.
findings.claim: 1) Go to Get Products (autodesk.com/education/edu-software) and select products. 2) Confirm eligibility with school-provided email (SheerID). 3) Create the institution's Autodesk account via the 'Complete Account Setup' email link. 4) Even if software is already installed, click 'Download' on the product card to trigger the entitlement. 5) Admins can enable SSO and assign products to up to 250 students per product.
findings.expiry: Same as student plan: 1 year, renewable annually while employed/contracting at a qualified institution; renew before expiry or restart. Note region-specific sunset of new network/multi-seat licenses (see sunset_notes).
findings.gotchas: Educational use only — no facilities use (designing/maintaining the school's own buildings) and no research run by commercial affiliates. ACIs are excluded. Multi-seat/network licensing is being phased out in favor of institution subscriptions (see sunset_notes), so long-term lab plans should migrate to Education institution subscriptions.

findings.name: 30-day free trials (users who don't qualify for the Education Plan)
findings.detail: Autodesk's standard 30-day product trial remains available to users who aren't eligible for the Education Plan (trial vs free: this is a time-boxed trial of the full commercial product, not the free education license). Official pages explicitly state trial participants may NOT use trials for training purposes.
findings.eligibility: Anyone not eligible for the Education Plan (e.g., training-center participants, unaccredited program attendees). No enrollment verification needed.
findings.claim: Select 'Try' / 30-day trial on product pages at autodesk.com, create an Autodesk account. (Trial page specifics not re-verified today — site blocked this fetcher; see confidence.)
findings.expiry: 30 days from activation, no renewal; after trial you must buy a paid subscription.
findings.gotchas: No training use permitted. Historically Autodesk trials don't require a credit card, but that was NOT re-verifiable today (autodesk.com returned HTTP 403 to the fetcher and the session web-search budget was exhausted), so treat the no-CC claim as unconfirmed. Trial licenses are commercial licenses — unlike the education plan, no usage restriction to education, but full paid version is commercial-only.

findings.name: Tinkercad — free consumer tier (always free, no enrollment needed)
findings.detail: Tinkercad (simple 3D design, 3D printing, circuits) is listed on Autodesk's education products page and is free to the general public; unlike the 1-year education plan it does not expire for casual use and needs no .edu email. It also remains available under the Education Plan as one of the included products.
findings.eligibility: Anyone with an Autodesk account; no eligibility verification, no age restriction stated beyond account terms; no region restriction found.
findings.claim: Sign up at tinker.com (now autodesk.com/tinker) — free, no credit card.
findings.expiry: No stated expiration (persistent free product, not a 1-year subscription like the rest of the education catalog).
findings.gotchas: Cloud-based only; data/egress and export limits apply per Autodesk's service terms. Free tier vs paid Tinkercad Pro: Pro adds advanced export/assembly features — free tier has export/length limits that were not re-verified today.

findings.name: Autodesk startup program — no active free startup offer found
findings.detail: As of 2026-10-22 no free 'Autodesk for Startups' / startup-credits program appears in today's search results for autodesk.com, and the education fronts are student/.edu-only. An earlier-generation Autodesk startup program (1-year professional licenses / discounts for young startups) could NOT be re-verified today: autodesk.com returned HTTP 403 to the fetcher and the session's web-search budget (200 shared calls) was exhausted on the startup-specific query. Treat any current startup program as unconfirmed; the safe conclusion is that Autodesk currently has no verifiable free tier, trial credits, or startup grant aimed at startups — free access is via the Education Plan (students/educators) or 30-day commercial trials.
findings.eligibility: Unknown/unverified — no startup age/funding-cap criteria found in any official page retrieved today.
findings.claim: Not determinable today. If one exists it would live under autodesk.com/company/startups or autodesk.com/education; neither could be fetched (403) or re-searched (budget exhausted).
findings.expiry: Unknown.
findings.gotchas: Do not cite a startup program without re-verification once autodesk.com is fetchable again; historical programs may have been folded into the 'Autodesk 10x' / A360-era discounts or discontinued in 2024-2025.

sunset_notes: 2025–2026 changes confirmed from official pages read today: (1) Single Sign-On mandate — Autodesk Education accounts will be required to use SSO (school credentials) starting August 7, 2026; schools like SMU enabled it in Aug 2025 (blog.smu.edu, 2025-08-07). (2) Multi-seat sunset — the US Education products page states 'Starting December 31, 2027, Autodesk will no longer offer new network and multi-seat licenses' and pushes institutions to Education institution subscriptions; the Asia-Pacific page (dated May 2025) states the cutoff as March 2026 for that region — i.e., the network/multi-seat lab-license model is being rolled off region by region starting 2026, so multi-seat classroom plans should be migrated now. (3) Startup program — status unverifiable as of 2026-10-22 (403 fetch blocks + exhausted shared web-search budget); no active free startup offer appeared in results. (4) No evidence today that the core 1-year free education license for students/educators changed, was reduced, or sunset — it remains 1-year, renewable, 3-device, full-feature. (5) Consumer free tiers (e.g., Fusion personal-use, AutoCAD Web basic) were NOT re-verified today and should be treated as unconfirmed; if they were sunset, that would land here after re-verification.

findings.name: Free PG Welcome Offer (India): zero fee on up to Rs 5,000/month of transactions
findings.detail: Official subscription-plans T&Cs state: 'Enjoy Free Payment Gateway for transactions up to Rs 5,000 per month, subject to applicable terms.' Zero setup fee, zero AMC, zero integration/support fee; REST API, official SDKs, webhooks, dashboard, refunds, payment links/pages included at no extra cost. Standard pay-as-you-go remains 2% domestic + 18% GST (Rs. 0 refund processing; corporate cards 2.15%); international cards up to 3% + 18% GST; UPI QR 0.99%. Free PG plan can be chosen at onboarding instead of any paid subscription plan; no credit card or subscription payment required to use the free plan.
findings.eligibility: Any business that completes onboarding + KYC and accepts Razorpay T&Us; offer is extended 'to a select set of users at Razorpay's sole discretion' and can be availed only against one user ID per user. Domestic transactions only; excluded methods: AMEX, Diners, credit-card-on-UPI, corporate cards, prepaid cards; international not covered. No .edu, no age/funding caps; registration status not stated.
findings.claim: 1) Sign up at razorpay.com, complete KYC/onboarding. 2) Choose the 'Free PG plan' when offered in onboarding (or keep a paid plan; the Rs 5,000/month zero-fee cap still applies). 3) Transactions up to Rs 5,000/month simply do not attract platform fees. No form, no opt-in beyond onboarding.
findings.expiry: No stated end date; it is a standing plan, not a time-boxed promo. Razorpay reserves the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue the offer at any time without prior notice.
findings.gotchas: Discretionary extension (Razorpay may offer it to 'a select set of users'); non-transferable, no cash redemption; refunds not available on cancellation unless Razorpay failed to provide the service; disqualification possible for misuse/fraud/suspicious activity. Rs 5,000/month cap is tiny for most businesses — it is a sandbox-grade perk, not a real zero-cost tier. The free-plan T&Cs also govern paid subscription plans: monthly credits expire every 30-day cycle with no carry-forward, and if one transaction exceeds the credit balance, no partial credit applies and plan rates apply to the whole transaction.

findings.name: 90-Day New-Merchant Welcome Offer (India): up to Rs 5 lakh of domestic payment value fee-free for 90 days
findings.detail: Per Razorpay's official blog 'Payment Gateway for Startups: Razorpay's First 90-Day Costs' (published 15 Oct 2026): eligible NEW merchants can receive amount credits covering up to Rs 5,00,000 of cumulative eligible domestic payments for 90 days from account activation, whichever limit is reached first. It is a payment-value threshold, not cash. Qualifying new merchants activated on or after 1 July 2026. One redemption per PAN or bank account (first activated MID qualifies); merchants who transacted previously are explicitly excluded.
findings.eligibility: New merchants only (no prior transactions on the account), India onboarding with KYC completion; activation on/after 1 Jul 2026; one redemption per PAN/bank account. Excluded payment methods: international payments, prepaid cards, corporate credit cards, American Express, Diners Club, and all EMI-based methods.
findings.claim: No separate claim step: complete new-merchant onboarding + KYC, and credits apply transaction-by-transaction automatically. Razorpay advises checking credit balance and expiry in the dashboard before unusually large payments.
findings.expiry: 90 days from account activation or Rs 5 lakh of eligible collections, whichever comes first; unused credits expire with the window (no carry-over).
findings.gotchas: A Rs 199 + tax KYC processing fee may still apply; GST/statutory levies on platform fees are NOT waived by the credit; separately priced services (instant settlements, recurring billing, etc.) not covered. Per-transaction mechanic: if a single payment exceeds the remaining credit balance, the fee applies to the full payment, not just the overage (Rs 10,000 credit left + Rs 15,000 payment at 2% = Rs 300 fee, not Rs 100). Fair-usage clawback: if card transactions exceed 90% of processed volume, Razorpay can withdraw the offer and apply retrospective standard charges from date of detection. Details come from Razorpay's blog; verify exact terms in the dashboard credits docs or T&Cs.

findings.name: Razorpay Startup Perks - Angel Funded tier: up to Rs 6 lakh payment credits + Rs 20 lakh SaaS card benefits
findings.detail: Official 'Razorpay Startup Perks - Rs 1Cr in Benefits' program, Angel Funded tier: up to Rs 3,00,000 FREE domestic payment credits + up to Rs 3,00,000 FREE international payment credits; Magic Checkout free for 90 days; collateral-free corporate credit card with up to Rs 20,00,000 worth of SaaS benefits (up to 1% cashback on growth spends, 500+ SaaS partner deals, 'save up to Rs 2,00,000 annually'); RazorpayX zero-balance current account unlocking an extra Rs 5 lakh GMV on the payment gateway; first 3 months of RazorpayX Payroll free; free incorporation and expert consultation via Razorpay Rize; dedicated relationship manager + round-the-clock support.
findings.eligibility: Per official T&Cs: must (a) be registered and operating in India; (b) be an Angel Funded startup - 'a newly established business entity that has received equity financing from individual high-net-worth investors'; (c) provide proof of funding 'that is satisfactory in Razorpay's discretion'; (d) hold a valid and active Razorpay account; (e) comply with documentation/verification. Eligibility decided by Razorpay at sole discretion. No .edu, and being 'funded' (angel round) is required; unfunded pre-seed startups do not qualify for this program. No explicit company-age or funding-size cap is stated in the T&Cs.
findings.claim: 1) Fill the Razorpay Startup Perks registration form (Typeform: razorpay.typeform.com/to/RpDLEkrM via the 'Get Started Today' / 'Talk to us' buttons on razorpay.com/m/startup-perks/) with company details and funding proof. 2) Razorpay reviews the account standing and verifies funding documentation. 3) On approval, credits/perks activate on the account; then claim product perks (payroll, RazorpayX account, corporate card). Alternatively schedule a call via the landing page; custom pricing also routes to the same form.
findings.expiry: Payment credits: valid until the earliest of (a) the offer limit is reached or (b) three (3) months from date of activation; applied on a first-come, first-served basis. Magic Checkout: 90 days. Payroll: first 3 months. No renewal/stated extension; Razorpay may modify, suspend, or discontinue offers at any time without notice.
findings.gotchas: Credits are 'non-monetary, non-transferable value units... no independent cash value'; cannot be transferred, exchanged, refunded, or encashed. Credits CANNOT be combined with other promotional offers unless expressly permitted. Actual grant 'may be lesser than what is captured in these Terms' per Razorpay risk assessment/underwriting (T&C 3.4a). Corporate card approval subject to credit underwriting - declinable for adverse credit history, minimum financial/vintage criteria, or failed address/operations verification. Razorpay can cancel eligible-user status at any time without notice. All amounts carry '*T&C apply'.

findings.name: Razorpay Startup Perks - VC Funded tier: up to Rs 50 lakh payment credits + Rs 50 lakh SaaS card benefits
findings.detail: Same program, VC Funded tier: up to Rs 30,00,000 FREE domestic payment credits + up to Rs 20,00,000 FREE international payment credits; Magic Checkout free for 6 months; 1 year of free intelligent payment routing; collateral-free corporate credit card with up to Rs 50,00,000 worth of SaaS benefits (up to 1% cashback on growth spends); RazorpayX zero-balance current account with extra Rs 10 lakh GMV on the payment gateway; first 3 months of RazorpayX Payroll free; free Rize incorporation + consultation; dedicated manager and round-the-clock support. Headlined as 'Rs 1Cr* FREE benefits for funded startups.'
findings.eligibility: Per T&Cs: (a) registered and operating in India; (b) a VC Funded startup - 'a business entity that has successfully secured institutional investment from a registered Venture Capital firm in exchange for equity, typically at Seed, Series A, or subsequent rounds'; (c) funding proof satisfactory to Razorpay; (d) active Razorpay account. Being VC-funded is required - bootstrapped or angel-only startups fall to the Angel tier.
findings.claim: Same claim path as Angel tier: form at razorpay.typeform.com/to/RpDLEkrM with company + funding proof; Razorpay verifies funding documentation against the account; on approval, credits and perks activate. 'Get a Custom Plan' CTA on the page also routes to the same form.
findings.expiry: Payment credits: until earliest of offer limit or 3 months from activation; first-come, first-served. Magic Checkout: 6 months. Intelligent routing: 1 year. Payroll: 3 months. No carry-over; offer can be suspended/changed at any time.
findings.gotchas: Same as Angel tier: non-monetary non-transferable credits, no combination with other offers, actual amount may be less than listed (underwriting), corporate card subject to credit underwriting, status cancellable without notice. A third-party tracker (Startup Grants India) summarizes the program as 'up to Rs 1.1Cr' for VC-funded (payments + SaaS card + GMV), but the official page headlines Rs 1Cr with '*T&C apply' - trust the official figures and T&Cs, not aggregators.

findings.name: MeitY Startup Hub (MSH) x Razorpay Rize offer: zero PG fees up to Rs 1 lakh or first 6 months, plus banking/payroll credits
findings.detail: Partnership announced 20-22 May 2025 (official Razorpay blog + Business Standard): every startup associated with MeitY Startup Hub gets access to Razorpay Rize with: Payment Gateway - zero PG fees on transactions up to Rs 1 lakh OR the first 6 months after onboarding, whichever is earlier; RazorpayX Business Banking - 3 months free, then 40% off the annual plan; Payroll - free for 1 year if fewer than 5 employees, otherwise 3 months free + 40% off the annual plan; seamless company incorporation with priority support (Pvt Ltd/LLP/OPC); Y-Combinator application support, pitch-deck reviews, founder toolkit; and quarterly shortlisted cohorts joining the Razorpay Rize Community (mentorship, founder directory, invitation-only masterclasses).
findings.eligibility: Startups 'associated with MeitY Startup Hub' (incubation centres, Centres of Excellence under the MeitY initiative), with emphasis on deep-tech (AI, robotics, IoT, blockchain, climate-tech) and Tier 2/3 city founders. No .edu required; this is a government-networked startup offer, not a student offer. Being in the MSH network is the gating condition.
findings.claim: 1) Be/start as an MSH-networked startup. 2) Access is via the MeitY Startup Hub channel (incubation centre / CoE you're associated with) which connects you to Razorpay Rize. 3) Complete incorporation/KYC, and the PG-fee, banking and payroll credits apply per the schedule above.
findings.expiry: PG fee waiver: earlier of Rs 1 lakh volume or 6 months from onboarding. Banking: 3-month free period, then 40% off annual. Payroll: 1 year (<5 employees) or 3 months + 40% off. Partnership is standing as of the May 2025 announcement; no sunset announced.
findings.gotchas: Credit amounts/durations come from the announcement blog, not a public T&C page - get exact wording in writing from Razorpay/MSH. Free period ends on different clocks per product (PG waiver is volume OR time; banking/payroll are time only). Rize Community cohort selection is quarterly and by shortlist - community access is not guaranteed to all MSH startups.

findings.name: DPIIT x Razorpay MoU (25 Mar 2026): zero professional fees for incorporation + credits/incentives for DPIIT-recognised startups
findings.detail: Government of India PIB press release (25 Mar 2026): DPIIT (Ministry of Commerce & Industry) signed an MoU with Razorpay; dedicated 'Startup Sahayak' platform launched for early-stage founders (incorporation, access to central/state schemes, funding guidance). DPIIT-recognised startups get: incorporation support at zero professional fees (excluding applicable government charges), access to credits and incentives across financial/business tools, mentorship, pitch-deck reviews, application guidance, curated founder communities, and regular knowledge sessions on applied AI, marketing, product and financial management via the Startup India Hub; innovation challenges planned under Bharat Startup Grand Challenge.
findings.eligibility: DPIIT-recognised startups (DPIIT 'Startup India' recognition) operating in India. Recognition is the gate; no .edu and no student track. No public per-item rupee values for the 'credits and incentives' - amounts are per the program onboarding.
findings.claim: 1) Obtain/confirm DPIIT recognition (Startup India Hub). 2) Engage via the Startup Sahayak platform / DPIIT-recognised-startup channel; Razorpay onboards, verifies recognition, and applies the zero-professional-fee incorporation plus credits/incentives. Details of the credit schedule are not on the public release - request the DPIIT-recognised startup sheet from Razorpay/DPIIT.
findings.expiry: MoU is standing as of 25 Mar 2026; no sunset date published. Government schemes referenced have their own eligibility windows.
findings.gotchas: Zero professional fees excludes government charges (stamp duty, ROC filing fees, etc.) - 'free incorporation' is not zero total cost. The release names no specific credit amounts; do not quote figures not in an official letter. This is a MoU: individual benefits are delivered 'as part of this initiative' and are subject to Razorpay/DPIIT program terms.

findings.name: Razorpay Rize: company incorporation at 'no hidden charges' + free startup communities
findings.detail: Razorpay Rize (razorpay.com/rize): company registration for Private Limited, LLP and OPC 'at No Hidden Charges' - service is described as 'low fees' (professional fee); government/statutory charges are still paid by the founder. Rize lists 14,950+ company registrations and 1,750+ founders. Founder communities (Rize / Tech+, D2C+, Xport+) join 'with no stated fee' (community members report 'there is no ask!'); member testimonial cites access to ~$11K of third-party credits across GCP, AWS, Azure, OpenAI as a community benefit. Rize for YC (YC-alum-guided application program: mock interviews, application reviews, weekly L&D sessions) is listed as 'all inclusive' with no separate price shown. Within the Startup Perks program, incorporation + expert consultation are explicitly a free perk for funded startups.
findings.eligibility: Incorporation: early-stage founders / small businesses in India (Rize page targets 'startups and small businesses'); no .edu. Communities: open to founders; no funding requirement stated on the public page (funding requirement exists only for the paid Startup Perks). No company-age cap.
findings.claim: 1) Sign up via razorpay.com/rize/ ('Join Community' is free). 2) For incorporation: select Pvt Ltd / LLP / OPC, complete KYC, pay government charges (professional fees at Rize 'low fees' - or waived if you qualify under Startup Perks / DPIIT MoU). 3) Communities and Rize-for-YC sessions come with membership.
findings.expiry: Communities: membership is ongoing while you remain a founder; third-party partner credits (cloud/AI) follow each partner's own program terms and can sunset independently. Incorporation: one-time service, no expiry concept. No published end dates.
findings.gotchas: Page FAQ answer on fees did not render in today's fetch - the definitive free-vs-paid status of incorporation fees comes from the 'low fees' + 'No Hidden Charges' banner; treat the professional fee as potentially payable unless you fall under Startup Perks (free) or the DPIIT MoU (zero professional fees). Government charges always apply on top. 'No hidden charges' is a marketing claim, not a refund guarantee. Partner cloud credits are subject to each partner's program and are not guaranteed to every member.

findings.name: Razorpay USA: 'first year free up to $50,000 in transaction volume' - limited-time promotion (likely not currently visible)
findings.detail: Razorpay's machine-readable US pricing reference (last updated May 2026) states: 'Limited-time promotion: Free card processing for the first year up to $50,000 in transaction volume. Verify current eligibility and terms at razorpay.com/us/pricing/.' US baseline rates: cards 2.70% + $0.30 per successful transaction; international/foreign cards +1.20% on top (total ~3.90% + $0.30); ACH direct debit 0.50% capped at $5 (returns $5, NOC $5, dispute $10); setup $0, monthly/AMC $0, refunds free, invoicing at no extra cost; Enterprise plan at $12M+ annual volume; restricted/high-risk industries on different fees. As of today (22 Oct 2026), the live US pricing page does NOT display this promotion anywhere - it appears to have been pulled, made application-only, or ended between the May 2026 reference update and now.
findings.eligibility: Region: United States (Razorpay US entity, Miami Beach, FL). The promo's exact eligibility and terms are not public (pricing.md defers to razorpay.com/us/pricing/, which no longer lists it); Standard plan is self-serve; Custom plan targets 'growing and early-stage businesses' (volume-based discounts, via sales). No student angle; no .edu. No funding cap; it is a customer-segment promo, not a funding-based one.
findings.claim: If currently available: sign up for the Standard (self-serve) US plan; no separate claim step is documented. Because the promo is not on the live page, the only verifiable path today is to ask sales at razorpay.com/us/ or check the machine-readable reference: razorpay.com/us/pricing.md (and companion India reference razorpay.com/pricing.md).
findings.expiry: Per the May 2026 reference: 'first year up to $50,000 in transaction volume' (volume cap, 12-month window). Status as of 22 Oct 2026: not shown on the live US pricing page - treat as unverified/sunset until confirmed with Razorpay US sales.
findings.gotchas: Only source for the promo is the May 2026 machine-readable pricing doc; the live pricing page omits it. A third-party deal site (joinsecret.com) still lists 'First $50,000 in transactions free' as a Razorpay deal, but that is not an authoritative source. Confirm in writing before budgeting around it. US sales tax is not collected by Razorpay. India (razorpay.com) startup offers do NOT apply to the US entity.

findings.name: Students: no free tier, no trial credits, no education license - only the student-only AI Buildathon internship (and education-business pricing)
findings.detail: No student/free-tier/dev-credits offer exists for individuals at razorpay.com as of 22 Oct 2026. (a) Razorpay Solutions: Education (razorpay.com/solutions/education/, page updated Aug 2026) is pricing for institutions/course businesses (2% per transaction, no setup/AMC) - it serves the education industry, not students. (b) The only student-targeted program is the Razorpay AI Buildathon (razorpay.com/buildathon/): a student-only competition for 6- or 12-month 'AI Builder Intern' internships, in-person in Bangalore from September; four build tracks (Agentic Commerce, AI Risk Manager, AI Revenue Recovery, AI Finance Controller, Open) using Razorpay test-mode APIs; 'no resume screening' - submit a public repo + 5-minute pitch video + architecture. Community reports (AWS Builder Center, Sep 2026) say 2nd/3rd/final-year students are eligible. It is a paid internship + competition, not a free tool/credit. (c) No .edu email benefits, no GitHub-Student-Pack-style offer, no 'student developer' plan - confirmed absent across razorpay.com and 2025-2026 web searches. The free developer surface is non-discriminatory: test/sandbox mode, REST API, official SDKs and webhooks are free for everyone at no cost, alongside the 0 setup/0 AMC baseline.
findings.eligibility: Students: Buildathon only - students (community-sourced: 2nd, 3rd, final year), in-person Bangalore; no .edu-only email gate advertised, no funding caps, no credit card required. No education license to claim; no one-time trial credits for students.
findings.claim: Buildathon: 1) pick a track; 2) build on Razorpay test-mode APIs; 3) show work (public repo, 5-min pitch video, architecture); 4) if selected, in-person hiring. Applications open on razorpay.com/buildathon/ (September cycle). Free API/SDK: sign up at razorpay.com, use test mode - no application needed.
findings.expiry: Buildathon is seasonal (announced September; submissions reported due early September for the 2026 cycle - re-open annually). Free API/sandbox: no expiry.
findings.gotchas: Do not conflate 'Razorpay for Education' (institution fee collection, a paid 2% service) with a student discount - it is not one. Do not cite .edu-free-tool lists (studentperks.dev, etc.) for Razorpay - none of the 150+ entries include Razorpay. Internship is paid (not a 'free offer') and location-bound to Bangalore, in-person. Test mode has no transaction limits publicly stated; it does not process real money.
